aids.nom: Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores
aids.description_en: Federal non-contributory pension for adults 65 and older (60+ for indigenous communities). 3,100 MXN paid every 2 months (1,550 MXN/month equivalent). Universal, no means-test for eligible age group.
Program to support smallholder farmers in rural areas. Monthly support of 5,500 MXN for agricultural production and training. Targets subsistence farmers with land.

aids.nom: Beca Benito Juárez para Educación Básica y Media Superior
aids.description_en: Educational scholarship for students in basic and upper secondary education. 1,600 MXN/month for media superior (upper secondary) level. Aims to reduce school dropout in vulnerable communities.
aids.organisme: Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP) / Secretaría de Bienestar

aids.description_en: Youth training and employment program. 4,310 MXN/month stipend for youth aged 18-29 not in school and not employed. Placed with businesses for 12-month training.
aids.organisme: Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social (STPS)

aids.description_en: Social health insurance for formal-sector workers and their families. Covers medical consultations, hospitalisation, maternity, disability and work-accident care through IMSS clinics and hospitals.

Housing credit for formal workers. Workers accumulate contributions (5% of salary by employer) in an individual housing sub-account. Eligible for low-interest mortgage to purchase, build or renovate a home.
aids.organisme: Instituto del Fondo Nacional de la Vivienda para los Trabajadores (INFONAVIT)

aids.description_en: Mexico City scholarship for students in public preschool, primary and secondary schools. Monthly transfer of approx. 530 MXN/month (primary) to 680 MXN/month (secondary) to reduce school dropout.
aids.organisme: Gobierno de la Ciudad de México / Secretaría de Educación CDMX

aids.nom: Pensión Alimentaria para Adultos Mayores CDMX
aids.description_en: Mexico City food pension for residents aged 60+ in CDMX. Monthly transfer to cover food needs. Complements federal Pensión Bienestar. Approx. 1,364 MXN/month (2025).
aids.organisme: Gobierno de la Ciudad de México / SIBISO
